loader: react-router: the export name a route's data loader takes
action: react-router: the export name a route's mutation takes
params: react-router: loader argument key holding the path parameters
Route: react-router: the element a route tree is written with
path: react-router: the Route prop holding a route's path pattern
index: react-router: the Route prop marking a route that answers its parent's path
children: react-router: the route-object key holding the routes nested under one
createBrowserRouter: react-router: the factory taking an array of route objects
createRoutesFromElements: react-router: the factory turning route elements into route objects
